d:
Dharavahik- dekh tamasha dekh
Kahani- savdhan khabardar hoshiyar
Lekhak,nirmata,nirdeshak- rajan kumar aahuja
Kahani ek aise ganv ki jahan ke naujvan ganv men kamaee ka koee zariya na hone ke karan roji-roti ki talash men shahar ki or rukh karte hain | hiralal bhi roji-roti ki talash men apni patni imarti ko chhorkar shahar jane ka man bana leta hai | patni se kiye vade hiralal shahar jakar naukri rhurhta hai aur kamaee ke paise ganv bhi bhejta hai | kahani eds ke bare men jagruk karti hai | iski sahi jankari,eds ke karan aur isse bachav ke upay natak ke dvara ganv valon ko samjhaya gaya hai|
